serialization_repair.reason: The first oversized serialization of this same artifact carried incorrect displayed j labels for the final radial level. It was replaced immediately with this compact authoritative summary. No statistical result, anchor count, hash, or coverage conclusion changed.

design.alternative_shell: 1 <= D_KL(Q||P) <= 1.1 for Gaussian Q=N(mu,r), mu>=0; negative mu follows by global sign symmetry

simulator.early_neighbor_groups: U=P^b; A=P^(T-b); V=P^x Q^(g-x) because b=g=16; B=Q^(H-b)
simulator.late_neighbor_groups: U=P^b; A=P^(T-b) P^x Q^(g-x); V=Q^b; B=Q^(H-b)
simulator.shared_path_generation: Generate exact homogeneous Gaussian subgroup sample means and chi-square within-SSEs once per path and reuse them for both adjacent candidates, preserving dependence.

transport.anchor_radius: rho_a=min_x kl(0.09||U_CP(a,x))/(64-x), using the one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound U_CP for the DIRECT JOINT adjacent-pair failure event
transport.binary_data_processing: D_KL(Q||Qa)<=rho_a implies adjacent-pair failure probability <=0.09 for every discrete offset

anchor_construction.method: At each fixed KL level start from the lower-variance endpoint, r=1, and upper-variance endpoint; compute all-offset transport coverage and repeatedly add the geometric midpoint of the largest uncovered log-r gap until that exact level is covered.
anchor_construction.reproduction_note: Reproduce anchor parameters, direct-joint counts and radii from the deterministic adaptation algorithm and seed ranges above; the compact certificate intentionally omits the 6307 raw counts.

continuum_shell_cover.outside_cell_test: For each rectangle bound min/max I exactly using convex g(r)=r-1-log r; discard if Imax<1 or Imin>1.1.
continuum_shell_cover.cell_ball_test: D_KL(target||anchor) is convex in (mu,r), so its maximum over a rectangle is attained at a corner. Certify a cell when one anchor's all-offset rho exceeds the maximum of its four corner KL values.
continuum_shell_cover.split_rule: Bisect the larger normalized span; mu arithmetically and r geometrically.
continuum_shell_cover.result: Conditional on the simultaneous Clopper-Pearson anchor bounds and ordinary float64 coverage arithmetic, every Gaussian Q in the full two-dimensional shell 1<=D_KL(Q||P)<=1.1 has adjacent-pair failure probability <=0.09 for all 17 discrete offsets.

engineering_counterexample_search.grid: 6 KL radii from 1 to 1.1 x 31 log-r points x all 17 offsets; 500 shared-path draws per point
engineering_counterexample_search.result: No mixed mean/variance point in this scan exceeded the exact-level I=1 region; empirical failure generally decreased outward. Engineering evidence only.

scope_limits: Coverage/root arithmetic remains ordinary float64 rather than directed-rounding/interval verified.
The power certificate is randomized over offline Monte Carlo certification randomness, not a closed-form analytic power theorem.
No extension to heavy-tailed or non-Gaussian alternatives.
exact_next_action: Extend the same direct-joint anchor-ball plus convex (mu,r)-rectangle cover from KL 1.1 outward, first through 1.25. In parallel replay the r76 anchor/cell inequalities with directed-rounding or interval arithmetic. If anchor density stops decreasing or a mixed-direction failure spike appears, retain the finite certified shell and derive a separate high-information analytic lower-tail handoff instead of assuming radial monotonicity.
